wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.detail: Three rows sum 100.00 + 250.00 + 50.00 = 400.00, equal to cover line 1 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE cells. The whole LAST-REPORT column is blank on every line, i.e. this is the FIRST report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide -- recorded cumulative. Generation-1 Carr form prints no schedule total (schedule_total null), so the cover line is the only anchor. Reconciled against line 1 ONLY. Cover line 2 (<=$50 aggregate): LAST and THIS blank, CUMULATIVE carries a badly degraded circular glyph that could be a 0 but cannot be read with confidence -- recorded null (printed but ILLEGIBLE), never 0. NB the filer itemized a contribution of EXACTLY $50.00 on Form A and line 1 includes it (the sum only reaches 400.00 with it), even though the statutory line is 'more than $50.00' -- the filer's own treatment, retained.

expenditures.detail: NO ANCHOR IS AVAILABLE ON EITHER SIDE OF THE COMPARISON. (a) The Gen-1 Carr form prints no schedule total. (b) Cover lines 3 and 4 ARE written on the form but the scan has lost the ink: at 600 dpi with normalization the THIS and CUMULATIVE expense cells resolve only to something like an 8-or-9 leading digit and a trailing pair, and the balance cell to a leading minus sign; both are recorded null (printed but ILLEGIBLE), never 0 and never guessed. (c) The row set is INCOMPLETE: line 11 (Advertising & Supply / Campaign Stickers) has an EMPTY amount cell on the form -- verified at 1200 dpi -- so it is excluded from the sum and the side is a FLOOR, not a total. The 12 legible amounts sum to 927.92 under my best reads, but three of those reads are low-confidence (lines 1, 5, 13) so even the floor carries uncertainty. Scope recorded cumulative because the LAST-REPORT column is blank on every cover line (first report of the cycle), which makes THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide by construction -- the contributions side proves the coincidence numerically (line 1 THIS == CUM == 400.00). A human should re-read the cover from a better scan if one is ever recovered.

gates.page_subtotal: Gen-1 form prints NO schedule total on either sheet -- no page-subtotal gate exists. p2 gates against the cover: rows 100.00 + 250.00 + 50.00 = 400.00 = cover line 1 THIS and CUM, EXACT. p3 CANNOT GATE: the cover's expense line is illegible and one row's amount is blank on the form; rows-sum floor 927.92 vs printed figure UNREADABLE. Both figures named, nothing adjusted. (For the record and NOT used as an anchor: filing_totals.csv notes the county's own summary sheet for the 4/9/2010 deadline states $897.17 expenses / -$497.17 balance; that is a DIFFERENT document, it does not equal my rows-sum floor, and no row was moved toward it.)
gates.row_count: Gen-1 ruled sheet, ~40 writing lines, scored against INK by eye. p2: 3 inked lines at the top -- 3 dates / 3 names / 3 addresses / 3 amounts, 3 rows emitted. p3: 13 inked lines at the top -- 13 dates / 13 payees / 13 purposes / 12 amounts (line 11's amount cell is empty), 13 rows emitted. Field-shift screen passed on both sheets: every date cell holds date-shaped content (line 4's is a partial date, see its note), no name-shaped content in any date cell, and payee and purpose counts match the row count.
gates.geometry_proof: p2: a 600 dpi crop of the amount column over the first four row bands renders '$100.00 / $250.00 / 50.00' in printed order and the fourth band EMPTY. p3: a 600 dpi crop over bands 1-5 renders '225.00 / 35.00 / $152.40 / $109.95 / 45.84' in order, and the crop over bands 12-13 renders '$20.00 / 121.50' followed by two EMPTY bands.
gates.balance_chain: CANNOT BE CHECKED: cover line 4 (balance) is written but illegible -- only a leading minus sign is recoverable, so the ending balance is negative but its digits are lost. Contributions cum 400.00 is legible; expenses cum is not, so no closure test is possible. Nothing inferred.

escalation_note: 600 dpi normalized crops of p3's amount column in three bands; 1200 dpi normalized crops of p3 lines 1, 5, 11 and 13 amount cells and of line 4's date cell; 600 dpi normalized crops of p1 cover lines 2, 3 and 4; 600 dpi normalized crops of p2's name column, address-column right edge (city/state) and amount column; a 600 dpi crop of p3 line 6's purpose cell. ImageMagick -normalize used throughout -- this scan is a degraded fax-grade copy and is the weakest document in the chunk.
notes: Cover confirms the chunk file's candidate and office and ADDS the seat: 'Full Name of Candidate Greg Aldred', 'Name of Office County Commissioner Seat A' (also written beside the signature), 'Office District Washington County', party Republican, Date 4-7-2010, RECEIVED APR 7 2010. County office, in scope. FILING DATE: the form is signed 4-7-2010 and stamped received APR 7 2010, while the filename says '4-9-10 update' -- the DOCUMENT governs (filing_totals.csv already carries 2010-04-07). This is the county's own 'Portal labels lie here' trap in action. Generation 1 (Carr Printing 5-5-PG, Utah Code 17-16-6.5) -- no in-kind column, no printed schedule totals. THE SCAN IS SEVERELY DEGRADED on the cover's money block: lines 3 and 4 are written but unreadable at any resolution, which is why filing_totals.csv publishes stated_total_expenditures and stated_ending_balance BLANK; my independent read reaches the same conclusion. Contributor mailing addresses/PO box/ZIPs and the candidate's own street address, home and business phones were DISCARDED at read time.
